action:
After a standard system update you need to restart Prosody to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that the LDAP authentication modules in Prosody Community
Modules did not fully verify XMPP addresses when checking for administrator
privileges. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to gain
administrator privileges.
isummary: Prosody Community Modules could be made to grant administrator privileges to an attacker.
